svg.title: Изометрическое сведение ладоней — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One centered figure only, upper body from waist, standing upright. Both open palms pressed together vertically in front of sternum, fingers pointing up, elbows bent and out to sides at chest height. Show the joined palms clearly. Static isometric hold. No equipment. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
